notes.title: CODE VEIN II - Release Date Reveal Trailer
notes.content:
[h2][b]A NEW FUTURE BEGINS FOR A WORLD IN PERIL IN [i]CODE VEIN II, [/i]COMING JANUARY 2026[/b][/h2][h2][/h2][p][/p][h2][i]Rewrite History and Save the World in the Next Major RPG[/i][/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="rVRzh7Y640M;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]The new [b]action RPG[/b] takes players on an epic journey where they wield time as a weapon, [b]traverse through past and present[/b] versions of an explorable world and uncover a dramatic battle to save the world. [/h3][h3] [/h3][h3][url="https://en.bandainamcoent.eu/code-vein/code-vein-2"][b]Code Vein II[/b][/url] features action-packed RPG play with engaging combat and a deep progression system for [b]character[/b], [b]weapon [/b]and [b]ability upgrades[/b]. [/h3][h3] [/h3][h3]Players will travel across vast environments with companions who factor large into a dynamic [b]Partner System[/b] as they take on challenging foes and massive, unforgettable bosses. [/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Ultimate Edition[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649559/3f161cd222ca86814b9e55fa72e98cedbcefea38.jpg"][/img][/p][p]
The [b]Ultimate Edition[/b] includes:[/p][list][*][p][b]CODE VEIN II[/b][/p][list][*][p]Custom Outfit Pack: Contains 3 costume sets and 1 weapon[/p][/*][*][p]Expansion DLC: Mask of Idris[/p][/*][*][p]CODE VEIN Character Costume Set: Contains 6 costumes based on characters from the original game, CODE VEIN[/p][/*][*][p]CODE VEIN II Digital Mini Artbook & Soundtrack[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Deluxe Edition[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649559/6ac109cacf8d24f3df53411fd7038ce38e49b451.jpg"][/img][/p][p]
The [b]Deluxe Edition[/b] includes:[/p][list][*][p][b]CODE VEIN II[/b][/p][list][*][p]Custom Outfit Pack: Contains 3 costume sets and 1 weapon[/p][/*][*][p]Expansion DLC: Mask of Idris[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Pre-order now to receive the following bonuses:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Stylized Forma Set[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Forma Face Paint[/b]: A cosmetic item which applies a forma design to the corner of your eyes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Twin Fangs of the Lone Wolf (Weapon)[/b]: Twin blades engraved with a special forma. Cut through your enemies like a wolf sinking its teeth into its prey with a powerful, lunging slice attack.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649559/d6e3e3a2c2765e44dff7b20c083c5c5e0531d415.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Discover everything we know so far [url="https://bnent.eu/CV2_LatestInfo"]HERE[/url][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fbnent.eu%2FCodeVeinII_LoreInfo"] [/url]![/b][/h3][p][/p][h3]Discover more :[/h3][h3][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2362060/CODE_VEIN_II/"][/dynamiclink][/h3]
